changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS role_permission ( role_permission_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, role_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES role_master(role_id), permission_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES permission_master(permission_id), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uk_role_permission UNIQUE (role_id, permission_id) );

changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.role_id, p.permission_id FROM role_master r CROSS JOIN permission_master p WHERE r.role_code IN ('SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN') ON CONFLICT (role_id, permission_id) DO NOTHING;
